title: TabularQGAN
summary: Official code release accompanying the paper 'TabularQGAN: A Quantum Generative Model for Tabular Data', training a quantum generative model on tabular EHR-style census data and comparing it against classical baselines. The classical baselines and evaluation pipeline call SDV's CTGANSynthesizer/CopulaGANSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, and evaluate_quality to generate and score synthetic tabular data.
